list.name: model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM (SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.request_log WHERE model != '' UNION ALL SELECT model FROM llm_gateway.usage_log WHERE model != '') ORDER BY model

list.name: api_key
list.label: Client API Key
list.query: SELECT k AS __text, k AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') AS k FROM llm_gateway.request_log) ORDER BY k

panels.title: Token Usage by Category

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT
        toInt64(sum(total_tokens)) as total_tok,
        toInt64(sum(prompt_tokens - cached_tokens)) as input_tok,
        toInt64(sum(cached_tokens)) as cached_tok,
        toInt64(sum(completion_tokens - reasoning_tokens)) as output_tok,
        toInt64(sum(reasoning_tokens)) as reasoning_tok,
        sum(cost) as total_cost
    FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
),
runrate AS (
    SELECT
        total_tok, input_tok, cached_tok, output_tok, reasoning_tok, total_cost,
        greatest(dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime) / 86400, 1) as elapsed_days, -- noqa: LXR
        toDayOfMonth(toLastDayOfMonth(toDate($__toTime))) as days_in_month -- noqa: LXR
    FROM totals
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT
        total_tok, input_tok, cached_tok, output_tok, reasoning_tok, total_cost,
        round(total_tok / elapsed_days * days_in_month) as month_tok,
        round(total_tok / elapsed_days * 7) as week_tok,
        round(total_tok / elapsed_days) as day_tok,
        total_cost / elapsed_days * days_in_month as month_cost,
        total_cost / elapsed_days * 7 as week_cost,
        total_cost / elapsed_days as day_cost
    FROM runrate
)
SELECT
    multiIf(input_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(input_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), input_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(input_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), input_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(input_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(input_tok)) as "Input Tokens",
    multiIf(cached_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(cached_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), cached_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(cached_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), cached_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(cached_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(cached_tok)) as "Cached Tokens",
    multiIf(output_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(output_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), output_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(output_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), output_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(output_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(output_tok)) as "Output Tokens",
    multiIf(reasoning_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(reasoning_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), reasoning_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(reasoning_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), reasoning_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(reasoning_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(reasoning_tok)) as "Reasoning Tokens",
    concat(multiIf(total_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(total_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), total_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(total_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), total_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(total_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(total_tok)), ' · $', multiIf(total_cost >= 1000000000, concat(printf('%.2f', total_cost / 1000000000), 'B'), total_cost >= 1000000, concat(printf('%.2f', total_cost / 1000000), 'M'), total_cost >= 1000, concat(printf('%.2f', total_cost / 1000), 'K'), printf('%.2f', total_cost))) as "Total",
    concat(multiIf(month_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(month_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), month_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(month_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), month_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(month_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(month_tok)), ' · $', multiIf(month_cost >= 1000000000, concat(printf('%.2f', month_cost / 1000000000), 'B'), month_cost >= 1000000, concat(printf('%.2f', month_cost / 1000000), 'M'), month_cost >= 1000, concat(printf('%.2f', month_cost / 1000), 'K'), printf('%.2f', month_cost))) as "Monthly Average",
    concat(multiIf(week_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(week_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), week_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(week_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), week_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(week_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(week_tok)), ' · $', multiIf(week_cost >= 1000000000, concat(printf('%.2f', week_cost / 1000000000), 'B'), week_cost >= 1000000, concat(printf('%.2f', week_cost / 1000000), 'M'), week_cost >= 1000, concat(printf('%.2f', week_cost / 1000), 'K'), printf('%.2f', week_cost))) as "Weekly Average",
    concat(multiIf(day_tok >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(day_tok / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'), day_tok >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(day_tok / 1000000, 2)), 'M'), day_tok >= 1000, concat(toString(round(day_tok / 1000, 2)), 'K'), toString(day_tok)), ' · $', multiIf(day_cost >= 1000000000, concat(printf('%.2f', day_cost / 1000000000), 'B'), day_cost >= 1000000, concat(printf('%.2f', day_cost / 1000000), 'M'), day_cost >= 1000, concat(printf('%.2f', day_cost / 1000), 'K'), printf('%.2f', day_cost))) as "Daily Average"
FROM avgs

panels.description: Token volume over the selected range, split into input (uncached), cache hits, output (non-reasoning) and reasoning. Total shows overall tokens · spend on the second row; Monthly/Weekly/Daily Average project the range total forward to a full calendar month / 7 days / 1 day (run-rate) and show the projected tokens · spend (tokens · $). Prompt caching shows up as Cached: cached input is billed at a steep discount, so a high Cached share is good.

panels.title: Cost Over Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfDay(timestamp) as time,
    round(sum(cost), 2) as "Cost ($)"
FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Spend per day over the selected range. The selected models and keys are additive: each bar is the total spend for that day across everything filtered in. Includes migrated history.

panels.title: Model Distribution

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_model AS (
    SELECT
        model,
        toInt64(sum(total_tokens)) AS tokens,
        sum(cost) AS cost
    FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND model != '' AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
    GROUP BY model
    ORDER BY tokens DESC
    LIMIT 20
)
SELECT
    model,
    tokens,
    round(cost, 2) AS cost
FROM per_model
ORDER BY tokens DESC

panels.description: Top 20 models by token volume over the selected range: each tile is a model sized by its token volume, with its spend in the tooltip. Tiles below the minimum area are merged into an overflow tile so no model collapses to an unreadable sliver. Includes migrated history.

panels.title: Provider Breakdown ($)
panels.description: Where the money goes: spend share per provider/credential (usage_log.provider_id). Vendor concentration at a glance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_provider AS (
    SELECT
        coalesce(nullIf(provider_id,''),'unknown') AS provider,
        count() AS requests,
        toInt64(sum(total_tokens)) AS tokens,
        sum(cost) AS cost
    FROM llm_gateway.usage_log
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND coalesce(nullIf(key_id,''), nullIf(api_key_id,''), 'unknown') IN (${api_key:singlequote}) AND model IN (${model:singlequote})
    GROUP BY provider
)
SELECT
    concat(
        provider, ' · ', toString(requests), ' req · ',
        multiIf(tokens >= 1000000000, concat(toString(round(tokens / 1000000000, 2)), 'B'),
                tokens >= 1000000, concat(toString(round(tokens / 1000000, 2)), 'M'),
                tokens >= 1000, concat(toString(round(tokens / 1000, 2)), 'K'),
                toString(tokens)),
        ' tok'
    ) AS name_str,
    round(cost, 2) AS value
FROM per_provider
ORDER BY cost DESC
